caption: The drawing depicts a single jug or pitcher with an ornate handle, set against a plain, light beige background. The jug is predominantly a dark brown color with areas highlighted to suggest shine and three-dimensionality. The upper part of the jug has a wide, flared spout and a large, curved handle that attaches to the body near the top and midsection, ending in a small decorative curl. The neck of the jug has textured diagonal lines, while the main body displays a crosshatched pattern forming diamond shapes. Around the lower body, there is a band featuring repeating circular designs with radiating lines within each circle, and beneath this band, a vertically striped texture encircles the base. The overall composition centers the jug within a rectangular border, with the artist's name, "N. Amantea," inscribed in the lower left corner outside the border.
title: Cream Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
